description: Phase A deterministic demo set for the zonneveld (solar field) track. The Groene contour compensation duty (art. 6.5a lid 3) versus the designation itself is the natural first policy axis.

scenarios.name: Groene contour treated as hard exclusion (nature first)
scenarios.description: FR-Z-04 carries the art. 6.5a lid 3 compensation marker in the baseline; this variant reclassifies the contour as a hard exclusion — no solar inside the zoekgebied voor nieuwe natuur at all.

basis.provenanceNote: NC-Z-04 (art. 6.5a lid 3) makes solar fields inside the Groene contour implicitly temporary via a compensation duty; this variant executes the strictest reading — exclusion — instead.

scenarios.name: Designation taken at face value (no Natura/ganzenrust carve)
scenarios.description: FR-Z-03 subtracts Natura 2000 and ganzenrustgebieden from the Gebied zonneveld; the toelichting-based carve is small because the designation already avoids those areas. This variant shows exactly how small.

basis.rationale: The carve follows from the toelichting on art. 5.5, not from an explicit lid; dropping it isolates how much area the interpretive carve actually costs. Purely analytical — not a legal reading.
basis.provenanceNote: NOT legally grounded as a reading of the verordening: the baseline's carve (NC-Z-03) is the defensible interpretation; this variant removes it to measure its footprint.

scenarios.name: Gebied zonneveld designation expanded by a 500 m band
scenarios.description: Buffers the art.-5.5 designation envelope (FR-Z-02) outward by 500 m — a programming-thought experiment, explicitly hypothetical.

basis.rationale: The designation envelope is a programming area, not a physical boundary; this hypothetical measures what a 500 m band would add. No instrument text supports the 500 m figure.
basis.provenanceNote: NOT legally grounded: the designation (NC-Z-02, art. 5.5) is cited, the 500 m band is the scenario's own parameter.
